Name: Nyapu-ish Portraits for Well Read
Author: Howaa
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
Portraits for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50426]Well Read[/url] using Nyapu's style & The Well Read Portraits as a base.

[b]Installation instructions[/b]
This is a file replacement mod ~ so you'll need to navigate to your mod folder, find Well Read, and drag my "assets" folder into the Well Read mod folder, allow my portraits to overwrite the originals, and you're done! 

[b]Requirements[/b]
SMAPI, Well Read 

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/201653948]Luminte[/url] for the Well Read mod & permission, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] for their portraits & generous permissions & once agian [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/118430843]nugmods[/url] for their Eli & Dylan portraits, I don't think I would have figured out how to make a convincingly Nyapu-ish style crow without having their art as a reference!  [/color]
